flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: No taxi/SMRT-specific code. Generic path: ocmseserviceapi workflows/furnish/FurnishSubmissionController; ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/furnish_processing/{services/FurnishProcessingService, helpers/FurnishApprovalHelper}; ocmsadminapi workflows/furnish/{manualreview/services/ManualReviewService, manual/ManualFurnishController, stafffurnish/controllers/StaffFurnishController} (officer input, not receipt from a taxi company)
note: Story status: User Story Removed, verdict stays Removed. The story asks OCMS to receive and update particulars from a taxi company and continue with reminders per Appendix B of Annex 1A. There is no interface or file intake from taxi companies; particulars come in only through the eService form (Corppass company or individual) or are keyed by an officer in the staff portal. After particulars are approved, a new offender is added and the stage is reset to RD1/DN1 so the generic reminder cycle runs, but the content of Appendix B of Annex 1A is not in the repo. The officer manual furnish code is logged in orphans as 'Removed tapi mirip'. No maintenance ticket mentions taxi companies.

steps.step: OCMS receives hirer/driver particulars submitted by the taxi company
steps.detail: There is no taxi-specific channel (grep smrt|taxi = 0; thirdpartyapi only has CES and AXS). A company logged in with Corppass can submit through POST /v1/furnishapplication, with ownerIdType 'B' and the ID from the session entityId (FurnishSubmissionController.java:66,80-84). That is the portal form for all companies, not receipt from a taxi company.

steps.step: OCMS updates the hirer/driver particulars on the notice
steps.detail: After the submission is synced to Intranet, the Furnish Processing cron runs addFurnishedOffender: the old offender indicator becomes 'N' (FurnishApprovalHelper.java:546,713-724), then the new offender is saved in Intranet (:563) and Internet (:580); the manual path goes through approveHirer/approveDriver (ManualReviewService.java:297,376). It applies to all eService submissions, not specifically to taxi companies.

steps.step: The taxi company sends particulars as a batch/file/API directly to OCMS
steps.detail: There is no file or API intake from an external company for particulars. The nearest thing is officer input: POST /furnish/officer/manual/single and /bulk (ManualFurnishController.java:104,166) and /staff-furnish/batch-furnish (StaffFurnishController.java:221), where an officer keys in the data received, not the system receiving it from a taxi company. Logged in orphans, not claimed.

steps.step: OCMS follows up with reminders to the hirer/driver per the Appendix B of Annex 1A workflow
steps.detail: After approval, the notice stage is reset to RD1 (hirer) or DN1 (driver) and the next processing date is at least tomorrow (FurnishApprovalHelper.java:649-652,664-666,677-686), so the per-stage reminder cycle continues. The per-stage reminder generation was not traced in this story, and the content of Appendix B of Annex 1A is not in the repo (cannot verify from repo).
